findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Client sends a specially crafted input that could be interpreted as a command by the server
findings.assumptions: The server is running in an environment where the input could be interpreted as a command (e.g., a shell). The input is not properly sanitized or validated before being processed.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Client sends more data than the buffer size (sizeof(uint32_t))
findings.assumptions: The buffer size is fixed and does not account for potential larger inputs. The server does not validate the size of the incoming data.
